summary: Ubisoft's anthology open-world shooter series; early console adaptations are tracked as separate releases where they substantially changed the PC original.

entries.title: Far Cry

primary.why: The original Far Cry was built for Windows and remains the highest-fidelity route; the console-focused Far Cry Classic is a later remake/re-release rather than a better primary.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release through Steam, GOG, or Ubisoft Connect with widescreen/compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge Far Cry Instincts/Predator/Vengeance into this PC entry; they are separate console adaptations.

entries.title: Far Cry Instincts

emulation.notes: Original Xbox hardware remains the baseline.

primary.why: Far Cry Instincts is an Xbox-only console remake with changed level design and added feral abilities.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or a verified Xbox emulation setup with an owned disc.

entries.remaster_caveats: Catalog separately from Far Cry PC.

entries.title: Far Cry Instincts: Evolution

emulation.notes: Original Xbox hardware remains the baseline.

primary.why: Evolution is an Xbox-only sequel/standalone follow-up to Far Cry Instincts.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or a verified Xbox emulation setup with an owned disc.

entries.remaster_caveats: Catalog separately from Far Cry Instincts and Predator.

entries.title: Far Cry Instincts: Predator

emulation.emulator: Xenia only if compatibility is acceptable

primary.why: Predator is the Xbox 360 package containing enhanced versions of Instincts and Evolution, making it the best single-console route for that branch.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 release on original/backward-compatible Xbox hardware if owned.

entries.remaster_caveats: Still not a replacement for the original Windows Far Cry.

entries.title: Far Cry Vengeance

emulation.notes: Use real Wii controls or a carefully mapped motion setup.

primary.why: Vengeance is the Wii-specific adaptation of the Instincts storyline with motion controls.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii/Wii U hardware with original controls, or use Dolphin only if motion controls are mapped acceptably.

entries.remaster_caveats: Motion-control adaptation; catalog separately from Instincts/Predator.

primary.why: Paradise Lost is the arcade light-gun Far Cry spin-off listed in the series release history.
primary.how_to_play: Play on the original arcade cabinet or a properly preserved arcade setup; normal home-console advice does not apply.

entries.title: Far Cry 2

primary.why: Far Cry 2 shipped on Windows, PS3, and Xbox 360; Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version through Steam, GOG, or Ubisoft Connect; use widescreen/framerate fixes only as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use modern fixes conservatively; preserve the base game plus Fortune's Pack if owned.

entries.title: Far Cry 3

primary.why: Far Cry 3 shipped on Windows, PS3, and Xbox 360, then received a Classic Edition on PS4/Xbox One; Windows remains the highest configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version through Steam, Ubisoft Connect, or another PC storefront; use compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Classic Edition is a console convenience route; Blood Dragon is separate and cataloged separately.

entries.title: Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon

primary.why: Blood Dragon was released on PS3, Windows, and Xbox 360, then as Classic Edition on PS4, Windows, Xbox One, and Stadia; Windows is the best configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version or Classic Edition on PC; use fixes as needed and document which build is archived.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document whether the original PC build or Classic Edition is archived.

entries.title: Far Cry 4

primary.why: Far Cry 4 shipped across PC and two console generations; Windows is the best high-fidelity route with DLC support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Gold Edition/current release with owned DLC installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Preserve DLC ownership and patch version.

entries.title: Far Cry Primal

primary.why: Far Cry Primal shipped on Windows, PS4, and Xbox One; Windows remains the most configurable high-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Apex Edition/current release with owned DLC installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Preserve DLC ownership and patch version.

entries.title: Far Cry 5

primary.why: Far Cry 5 shipped on Windows, PS4, Xbox One, and Stadia; Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Gold Edition/current release with DLC installed and current patch noted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Preserve DLC ownership and patch version.

entries.title: Far Cry New Dawn

primary.why: New Dawn shipped on Windows, PS4, Xbox One, and Stadia; Windows is the most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows current release with owned Deluxe content installed and current patch noted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Preserve patch version and owned extras.

entries.title: Far Cry VR: Dive Into Insanity

primary.why: Far Cry VR is an exclusive Zero Latency location-based VR experience set in the world of Far Cry 3.
primary.how_to_play: Book/play at a supported Zero Latency VR venue; there is no home platform route.

entries.title: Far Cry 6
entries.definitive_edition: Game of the Year / current Windows release

primary.version: Game of the Year / current PC release
primary.why: Far Cry 6 shipped on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Stadia; Windows is the most configurable high-fidelity route and supports the full DLC package.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release with DLC installed and high-resolution texture pack only if hardware supports it cleanly.

entries.remaster_caveats: Stadia is historical only; high-resolution texture pack has hardware requirements.
